Community Resource Directory - CCM Health Hospital & Clinics : CCM Health
The Online Community Resource Directory is now available on the CCM Health website. This directory includes a wide variety of community services and support organizations across more than 30 categories - spanning support for seniors, child development, domestic violence, community support groups, and much more.
On the directory page, you'll find listings like:
* Advanced Recovery Opportunities (ARO) (Montevideo) - Peer recovery specialists
*Alzheimer's Association - 24/7 helpline
*CCM Health Montevideo
*Chippewa County Family Services
*Countryside Public Health
*Prairie Five
... and many others like thrift stores, food markets, police departments, and more.
